notes: Partition verified: 30 source, 44 target, each used once.

The italic *the fire* realizes the pronoun הִיא rather than being added, headed on the noun carrying the referent; the possessive לְ of לָאֵשׁ is unrepresented because the ASV recasts the clause as *the fire was bright* (rules 40, 43).
*went up and down* is one idiomatic rendering of the Hitpael participle, its internal *and* included, headed on the verb (rule 44).
